hypothesis.statement: A verified v4 mesh cannot reach MetaHuman if downstream handoffs still reference stale packages or the workstation lacks installation headroom.
hypothesis.action: Create an immutable v002 handoff bound to v4 manifest/mesh/topology checksums and audit disk usage read-only without deleting user data.
hypothesis.expectedResult: The next UE session consumes only v4 and the user can make an informed, recoverable disk-space decision.

readOnlyDiskAudit.action: inspect Docker images, containers and volumes; require user approval before pruning
application caches are generally regenerable but should be cleaned selectively
dependency/build caches are regenerable; do not remove while builds run

remainingBlockers: user-authorized recovery of at least 35.07 GiB
qualityBoundary: v002 prepares the first MetaHuman solve only; it does not approve the MPFB face or claim AAA quality.
decision: Use v002 exclusively. Do not start the large UE installation or prune Docker until explicitly authorized.
